generators.name: module:make
generators.description: Create a new module.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: The names of modules will be created.

options.name: plain
options.description: Generate a plain module (without some resources).

options.name: api
options.description: Generate an api module.

options.name: web
options.description: Generate a web module.

options.name: inertia
options.description: Generate an Inertia module (Inertia controller + JS pages, no Blade views).

options.name: disabled
options.description: Do not enable the module at creation.

options.name: force
options.description: Force the operation to run when the module already exists.

options.name: author-name
options.description: Author name.

options.name: author-email
options.description: Author email.

options.name: author-vendor
options.description: Author vendor.
